correctness.rationale: Every boundary and cycle can be generated from the 14 XOR-zero planes. An algebraic boundary argument proves rank 35 of the present tetrahedron boundaries and H3 free rank 21. A signed 21-by-21 tetrahedron-coordinate submatrix of 84 cycles has exact integer determinant -1, so it spans the entire primitive kernel lattice; the standard-library verifier independently reproduces that determinant and all 84 boundary-zero identities. All induced five-sets and 28 six-sets, local ranks, and the 1344-element affine orbit are exhausted. The proof does not infer an infinite claim from finite sampling.

value.rationale: The unique eight-point Steiner quadruple system is a canonical highly symmetric rank-four binary matroid. Its minimal six-vertex primitive top-homology carriers, transitive orbit of 84 explicit spheres, and small saturated integral chain basis refine ordinary Betti numbers in a way naturally useful for geometric cycle representatives and symmetry-aware calculations; not an arbitrary slice or a routine restatement of abstract shellability.
